text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy r-2026-03-08-09 v1.8.3 -> eu-west-1
- Canary 5% at 02:00 UTC, ramp to 100% by 02:30 UTC
- Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC
- Release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/1.8.3

alice: Heads-up — there is an ongoing incident in #incidents about model cache warming failures in eu-west. @sre-oncall can you advise if we should pause the rollout? :warning:

sre-oncall: Investigating. Initial signal points to blobstore latency causing KV cache warms to fail. Recommend HOLD on any rollout to eu-west until we confirm stability. Ping @ben-ml for model pin suggestion.

ben-ml: Agree with hold. Suggest pin eu-west to v1.8.2 for safety; we can cut a hotfix later if needed. I'll prep a pinned artifact and a smoke test.

deploy-bot: Hold placed on rollout r-2026-03-08-09. Canary aborted, scheduled jobs for eu-west paused.
To resume manually: `/deploy resume r-2026-03-08-09 --region eu-west-1`
Auto-reschedule timer set to +6h unless cancelled.

alice: Thanks. Proposing we shift the change window to 08:00-10:00 UTC to avoid overlap with SRE planned infra ops later this morning. Thoughts?

ellie: 08:00 UTC works for EMEA customers. We should call out in the release notes that eu-west is pinned to v1.8.2 until infra stabilizes.

maria-sre: ETA on the blobstore fix is ~2 hours if our deploy of a config tweak goes cleanly. If that lands sooner we can try an earlier resume.

deploy-bot: Auto-reschedule updated: new tentative start 08:00 UTC. Stakeholders notified. Suggested changelog entry: 'eu-west temporarily pinned to v1.8.2 due to blobstore stabilization work.'

alice: Can we run a mirrored canary (traffic mirror) at 1% to validate without impacting users?

ben-ml: We can mirror traffic for smoke validation but we should not route live traffic. Recommend internal smoke test against pinned v1.8.2 and separate canary for v1.8.3 later.

sre-oncall: If you mirror, please disable KV cache warming in the mirrored path to avoid extra load/cost.

[~2 hours later]
maria-sre: Blobstore latency normalized and config roll applied. Monitoring looks stable for the last 10m. I recommend resuming to pinned v1.8.2 first and delaying v1.8.3 full rollout until we run an extended canary.

ben-ml: Agreed — resume with pinned v1.8.2 at 08:00 and run a separate 1-hour canary for v1.8.3 at 09:00 for verification.

alice: OK, resuming rollout r-2026-03-08-09 for eu-west at 08:00 to pinned v1.8.2. Release notes updated and CHANGELOG entry added. If we see regressions we'll rollback to v1.8.1 immediately.

deploy-bot: Deploy resumed: Canary 5% at 08:00 -> ramp to 100% at 08:30 for r-2026-03-08-09 (pinned to v1.8.2 for eu-west). Will post progress updates. :rocket:

alice: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short postmortem about the scheduling friction and a proposal to add an incident-triggered deploy hold checklist to the runbook.
